records.text: This card is for groceries from FreshCart only. Seventy-five a week is the budget. Last spring Femi ran up a $212 snack order on my main card. That's why I keep the cap. Leave changes to it and its verification codes to me.
I will leave the card limit and its verification codes to you.
If the order is over, cut snacks first. Never cut Femi's lactose-free milk or what I need for Thursday dinner. If it's still over, ask me.
I will cut snacks first, keep the lactose-free milk and Thursday dinner, and ask if the order is still over.
No energy drinks for the kids, no matter who asks.
My personal Visa ending 2290 is Grace-only. Never use it.
I will not order energy drinks, and I will not use the Visa ending 2290.
